action: If anyone in your organisation has built apps on Grok Build (grok.me): list them, turn on sign-in or take them down, remove any passwords from the app code and change those passwords. Do not rely on the default setting.
exec: Apps built by staff with AI tools may be public by default, exposing internal documents and passwords without anyone noticing.
plain: Researchers found that about 35,000 small apps built with the Grok Build tool could be opened by anyone without signing in. Some revealed internal documents and passwords. The vendor kept the open-by-default setting.
summary: Researchers at Claroc counted 35,578 of 37,571 live apps on grok.me reachable without authentication, some exposing internal documents and plaintext passwords in client code. The vendor removed 24 of its own staff apps but kept the open default.
title: Researchers find about 35,000 Grok Build apps open without sign-in

validation.note: Researcher finding reported by two independent write-ups.
